subject: CloudCart demo follow-up: deployment pathway checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Kahn <samira@cloudcart.com>
Cc: CloudCart Ops <ops@cloudcart.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: CloudCart demo follow-up: deployment pathway checklist

Hi Samira — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and the things we need to decide to scope a pilot: 

- Recap: you showed the product search assistant use case (user-facing suggestions + merchant admin reranking). Primary constraints are PII-sensitive merchant data ingestion and 2–3s 95th percentile latency on autocomplete.
- Planned pilot traffic: 200k requests/day, average request ~45 tokens, peak bursts ~120 req/s for short windows.
- Questions we need answered to recommend a deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private):
  1) Data residency / retention constraints: do you need all logs/audit kept in your VPC or do you allow logs to be processed in Redwood hosted environment?
  2) Key management: do you require customer-managed keys (BYOK) / HSM for token encryption at rest?
  3) Network: is there a requirement for VPC peering or private connectivity (no public internet egress)?
  4) Throughput SLA: do you expect steady throughput or heavy daily bursts? Any predictable schedule?

Next steps I propose:
- Please confirm the three items above (data residency, KMS requirement, private networking).
- If Hosted is acceptable, we can provision a sandbox with the Quickstart and a temporary endpoint (default sandbox rate ~60 req/s, can be increased for pilot). Attached is the quickstart PDF and a CSV with the sandbox endpoint details.
- If you need BYOK or VPC-only connectivity, we should scope a Dedicated or Private plan — I can loop in engineering for a posture assessment.

Attachments: redwood_quickstart.pdf (stub), sandbox_endpoints.csv (stub)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
[jordan.blake@redwood.ai]

From: Samira Kahn <samira@cloudcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCart demo follow-up: deployment pathway checklist

On Sun, Nov 7, 2026 at 3:08 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samira — thanks again for the demo time today. Quick recap and the things we need to decide to scope a pilot: 
> ...

Thanks Jordan — great recap. A few answers and follow-ups from our side: 

1) Data residency: for the pilot we can allow processing in your hosted environment, but logs containing merchant PII must not persist longer than 30 days and need to be exportable on request.
2) KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys for at-rest encryption if possible; if Hosted can’t support BYOK immediately, tell us what controls you provide and if there is a roadmap for BYOK.
3) Networking: we would prefer VPC-only for production, but sandbox/demo can be over the public API.
4) Throughput: the 200k/day is a good estimate; bursts to 120 req/s are expected during promotions (10–20 minute windows). Sustained baseline 15–20 req/s.

One more operational question: what are your default per-endpoint rate limits for Hosted trials and how quickly can you raise them for a pilot? Also: does the sandbox support streaming responses for autocomplete use-case?

Samira
Head of Product, CloudCart
samira@cloudcart.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Kahn <samira@cloudcart.com>
Cc: CloudCart Ops <ops@cloudcart.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CloudCart demo follow-up: deployment pathway checklist

Samira — thanks for the clear answers, helpful. Quick responses inline: 

- Data residency/retention: Hosted supports configurable retention policies; for pilot we can set a 30-day retention for logs and provide an export (CSV/JSON) on request. For production with stricter controls we recommend Dedicated or Private.
- BYOK / KMS: Hosted currently offers envelope encryption with Redwood-managed keys; customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS is available on Dedicated and Private. We do have a roadmap item to offer BYOK for Hosted Enterprise customers — if this is a firm requirement for production we should scope Dedicated/Private.
- Networking: sandbox uses public endpoints (TLS). For production VPC-only we would use Redwood Private or Dedicated with VPC peering.
- Rate limits & scaling: default sandbox per-endpoint throttle is 60 req/s with a burst allowance; for pilot we can request a temporary increase to 150 req/s for 48 hours while we run your promotion windows (ops approval required). Production Dedicated pools allow sustained throughput that matches your 120 req/s bursts easily with predictable SLOs.
- Streaming: yes, sandbox endpoints support streaming responses for autocomplete use-cases; we’ll include a small example in the quickstart PDF.

I’ve attached the quickstart and a CSV that lists the sandbox endpoints and example cURL calls. Proposed next steps: 
1) You confirm you want the sandbox increase for the pilot promo window and provide the target dates.
2) If BYOK/VPC required for production, we’ll schedule an engineering posture call to scope Dedicated vs Private and produce a cost estimate.

If you’re ok I’ll loop in Ben and Marissa to get the ops thumbs-up for the temporary rate increase and to get a rough Dedicated cost ballpark for CloudCart.

— Jordan

Attachments: redwood_quickstart.pdf (stub), sandbox_endpoints.csv (stub)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2026 10:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: CloudCart demo follow-up: deployment pathway checklist

Ben / Marissa — forwarding the thread with CloudCart (see answers from Samira). TL;DR: pilot traffic ~200k/day, bursts to 120 req/s, sandbox increase to 150 req/s requested for two promo windows (TBD). Pilot can run on Hosted for now with 30-day retention and sandbox streaming, but production will likely need BYOK/VPC.

Asks: 
- Can we approve a temporary sandbox throughput bump to 150 req/s for two 48-hour windows? Ops impact minimal but need sign-off.
- If we need to price a Dedicated baseline for CloudCart (sustained 120 req/s with predictable SLOs and BYOK), can someone give a rough monthly estimate and a ballpark lead time for provisioning?
- Also flag if there are any security blockers for giving an external ops team a temporary increase.

I can set up a 30-minute posture call with engineering if you want to walk through the BYOK/VPC requirements.

Thanks — Jordan
